abstract: Based on the large deflection theory for the extensible elastic beams, the governing equations of post-buckling of a cantilever elastic beam subjected to a non-conservative distributed tangential follower force along the central axis were established. They consist of a boundary value problem of ordinary differential equations with strong non-linearity, in which seven unknown functions were included and the arc length of the deformed axis is considered as one on the basic unknown functions. By using shooting method and analytical continuation, the nonlinear boundary-value problem was numerically solved as well as the post-buckling configurations of the deformed beam were obtained. The results show that the features of the equilibrium paths of the cantilever beam subjected to a non-conservative load are evidently different from those to a conservative one.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm of Position Based on TDOA/DR Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: GPS/DR integrated navigation in outdoor GPS signal better circumstances, can provide high-precision positioning and navigation, but the range of human activities is not just outside, they can also travel and stay in the various buildings. At this point, GPS signal is almost impossible to obtain, and DR will diverge due to no amendments for long time, therefore, GPS/DR system can not provide long time and high-precision navigation information indoors. For these reasons, this paper studies based on time difference of arrival (TDOA) positioning method, using ultrasonic sensors to achieve indoor TDOA positioning, and combined with the DR system to correct and improve the DR system error divergence problem, so as to enhance the navigation system positioning capacity.

articleTitle: Optimization of Preparation of Corn Starch Phosphates of High Thermal Viscosity by Response Surface Methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The preparation of corn starch phosphates which possess height thermal viscosity was optimized in this study. A central composite design of response surface methodology involving phosphate (sodium dihydrogen phosphate and disodium hydrogen phosphate) concentration, ratio of sodium dihydrogen phosphate and disodium hydrogen phosphate, phosphorylation temperature and urea concentration was used, and second-order model for thermal viscosity was employed to generate the response surface. The optimum condition for preparation of corn starch phosphates of high thermal viscosity was as follows: phosphate concentration 4.94%; ratio of sodium dihydrogen phosphate and disodium hydrogen 0.80, phosphorylation temperature 145°C; urea concentration 5.5%. The predicted value for thermal viscosity of corn starch phosphates at the optimum condition was 7652 cP. Experimental verification gave value of 7550±25 cP.

articleTitle: Fracture Mode of High Strength Steel Thin Plates with Elliptical Hole
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In the simple tension fracture experiment of thin plates with elliptical hole fabricated from high strength steel Q345, the effect of the ratio of the major axis to the minor axis of the elliptical hole on the fracture mode was studied. The experiment results showed that the macroscopic crack was initiated at the tip of the major axis of the elliptical hole. For the specimens with sharp elliptical hole, the first crack quickly expanded along the path vertical the loading direction until it ruptured. For the specimens with blunt elliptical hole, it was difficult to observe the process of the first crack, and the specimens ruptured at the critical section almost at the same time. The location of fracture load lay at the necking phase of load-displacement curve. The fracture ductility is lower and the ultimate strength is slight higher for the specimens with sharper elliptical hole.

articleTitle: The Application of CAE in English Teaching to Cultivate Learner Autonomy
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of multi-media and computer technology, English teaching aided by multi-media computers has made great progress. This paper mainly introduces a new English writing approach and how to make use of CAE (computer-aided education) to cultivate learner autonomy and realize life-long learning.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Steel Corrosion Expansion Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Steel corrosion is a major reason for the durability of reinforced concrete structures. The simulation of steel corrosion is the key to predict the life of concrete. This paper summarized the simulation methods of steel corrosion and had an equivalent simulation to steel corrosion based on the principle of thermal expansion and contraction. Finally, according to this method the destructive process of reinforced concrete beams was successfully simulated.

articleTitle: Estimation and Test of Parameters for Two 0-1 Populations with Partially Missing Data
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, the estimation and test of parameters for two 0-1 populations with partially missing data are given firstly, then the asymptotic normality and the strong consistency of this estimation are proved. The limit distribution of the likelihood ratio statistic is obtained.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Matter-Element Model on Evaluation of Sand Liquefaction Based on Coefficients of Combined Weights
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The problem of sand liquefaction is still an important research direction for Geotechnical Engineering at present. Because of the complexity, uncertainty and the fuzziness of the effective factors for evaluating sand liquefaction, the entropy value theory is applied to combine with fuzzy matter-element and approach degree to establish a fuzzy matter-element model based on coefficients of weights that combine with an entropy weight and a weight attained by Delphi. The problem of weight allocation can be avoided by employing the method suggested in this paper. The calculation result for an example is compared with the standard perforation test (SPT). The results indicate that the proposed method is reasonable and practical.

articleTitle: Electronics Properties of Single-Walled Twisted Carbon Nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Electronic properties are calculated and simulited by using density functional theory based on the nonequilibrium Green's function when a zigzag single-wall carbon nanotube (SCNTs) is twisted. We found that the twist of the single-wall carbon nanotube decreases their transmission function in certain energy ranges but some peaks are higher than unit despite twisting strongly affects the electronic structure of SCNT. The transmission peaks reduces gradually with twisting angle increasing. In addition, SCNT develops a Fermi-level which initially scales linearly with twisting angle and then reaches a constant value, the energy band gaps decrease with the twisting angles. All results indicate that SCNTs have lower electronic transport performance when the twisting angle increases, especially for large twisting angles.

articleTitle: Optimezed Rock Mass Strength Parameter via PLS-RBF Neutral Network
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The neutral network further development is restricted in the system to some extent. The 3 layers RBF neutral network has the ability that self-study and self-remember, but sometimes because of serious multi-correlation between the variables, and a few observations while many variables, there usually will result into paralyzing in study. The partial least square regression has its advantage of building the calculation model between the variables with strong multi-correlation, especially much effective on a few data and many variables. So a new and effective method-improved neutral network has been introduced. The neutral network based on the partial least square regression. The results of example show the improved method has a few calculations and high accuracy, and provide a new way for valuing the rock mass strength parameters. Its network has been applied extensively.

articleTitle: Superconvergence of Finite Element Methods for Linear Quasi-hyperbolic Integro-differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: We consider finite element methods applied to a class of quasi-hyperbolic integro-differential equations. Global strong super convergence, which only requires that partitions are quasi-uniform, is investigated for the error between the approximate solution and the Sobolev-Volterra projection of the exact solution. We employ a special method for initial value selection to study super convergence of the error. Two order super convergence results are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficiency of Regional Agricultural Production Based on Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: A reasonable evaluation index system of agricultural production efficiency was constructed in this paper. According to DEA Model, we calculated agricultural production efficiency for 18 cities of Henan province in 2008. The result showed that 7 cities were efficient in agricultural production and others were relatively inefficient. Finally, some suggestions were put forward in order to improve agricultural production efficiency in Henan Province.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Design for Gradient Stiffness Leaf Spring
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Gradient stiffness leaf spring is of a positive meaning for increasing the ride smooth of vehicle, which has a more stable natural frequency of leaf spring stiffness. A multi-objective optimization model of Gradient stiffness leaf spring of vehicles is established according to a certain light truck. Using Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm, the model is solved on the Optimal Design platform Matlab software. A optimal structure design scheme and optimization design parameters are obtained under the goals of the minimum total mass of the spring, minimum maximum stress in the roots of main spring, minimum maximum stress in the roots of auxiliary spring.

articleTitle: Persistence and Periodicity of Nonautonomos n-Species Cooperative System with Feedback Controls and Smith Growth for Prey
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, a non-autonomous n-Species Lotka-Volterra cooperative system with feedback controls and smith growth for prey is investigated. By using Comparability Theorem, constructing Lyapunov function and Continuation Theorem, a set of easily verifiable sufficient conditions are obtained to guarantee the permanent and Positive periodic solution global attractivity of the system.

articleTitle: A Convolution Formula for Normalized Trigonometric B-splines and Its Application to Geometric Modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper we present sum and convolution formulae for normalized uniform trigonometric B-splines of any odd order. As an application of the convolution formula we derive a subdivision algorithm for generating normalized trigonometric spline curves of any odd order.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis and Comparison of the Algorithms of Image Foreground Extraction
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Foreground extraction is widely used in pattern recognition, movie and arts, etc. And the most important part of Foreground extraction is detecting the image edge. By detecting the image edge, we can build the models to extract foreground from the image through region, pixel or color. This paper begin with the analysis and evaluation of several typical algorithms of edge detection operator, and then the mixture Gaussian model which based on the foreground and background colors basic model is given to balance the insufficient of two models. Next we get matrix E(x) from the mixture Gaussian model, and then realize foreground extraction by maximum flow minimum cut algorithm cutting. Finally as the parameter's change, the extracted effect is analyzed.

articleTitle: A Weighted Difference Scheme and Calculation of Parabolic Equation
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In practical simulations, difference algorithms are often chosen to solve large partial differential equations. In this paper, a new weighted three-implicit difference scheme is constructed for one-dimensional parabolic equation. The truncation error and stability of difference scheme are studied in detail. Numerical results show that the new method is feasible and effective, indeed.

articleTitle: A UML-Based Joint Operation Static Model
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Bringing forward static frame class and the rule of the UML-based joint operation model, and explicating every class in detail.

articleTitle: alpha-amylase and Glucose Oxidase as Promising Improvers for Wheat Bread
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The effects of alpha-amylase and glucose oxidase as bread improvers on the textural and thermal properties of bread were evaluated by the rapid viscosity analysis and differential scanning calorimetry. It was found that alpha-amylase and glucose oxidase could improve the specific volume and crumb porosity, retard the bread staling and increase the flour ethanol index. Therefore, alpha-amylase and glucose oxidase could be considered as the potential texture modifier for baked food.

articleTitle: A New Computer Tracking Method for Crack Tip Propagation
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: According to the COD (crack opening displacement) criterion of elasticity-plasticity fracture mechanics, we can decide whether the structures including crack are safe or not. However, the theory basis of the COD criterion, which is Dugdale model, is not agree with the fact crackle. In order to research the displacement field around the fact crack tip, tracking the location of crack tip is very important. So, a new computer tracking method is provided to track the crack tip and measure the movement curve of the crack peak. Because the crack opens slowly, the similary between the front and back images of crack tip propagation is high. The computer tracking method based on the optimum image correlation algorithm is feasible. By the tracking experiment of the samples of thin paper and lumber block including the premade crack under the action of gradual loadings, the crack tip is successfully tracked. And the moving curve of the crack tip is also obtained. In this way, the computer tracking method provides a new dynamic experiment means to quantitatively analyze the stress-strain fields around the crack tip according to the images of displacement fields around the crack peak at the next work.

articleTitle: (epsilon, epsilon Vq (lamda, mu))-Fuzzy Regular * -Semigroups
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the definitions of (ϵ, ϵ Vq<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(λ, μ)</sub>)-fuzzy regular * - semi groups and generalized fuzzy regular *-semi groups. Based on these, the properties of level sets and characteristic function of them are discussed. Besides, we also give their equivalent forms and properties of homomorphic image and homomorphic pre image in a homomorphim of semigroups.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Thermal Environment in Mine Based on Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Considering shortage of data and many complicated influence factors about heat harm in mine, an estimation model of thermal environment in mine based on support vector machine is put forward in this paper. Theory of support vector machine regression is analyzed. The influence factors about heat harm in mine are summarized. Four main influence factors are proposed as evaluation indexes of thermal environment. Learning samples are constructed on the basis of practical data from some mines in China. Leave one out cross validation shows accuracy of the estimation method. Experiment shows that the method is highly operational with high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Computer Simulation and Stability of a Virus Infection Model with Nonlinear Immune Response
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, a virus infection dynamics model with nonlinear immune response is studied. By analyzing the corresponding characteristic equation, the local stability of each of feasible equilibri of the model is discussed. By constructing appropriate Lyapunov functional, the global stability of the infection-free equilibrium and the immune-free infection equilibrium and virus infection equilibrium are proved. Numerical simulations are carried out to illustrate the theoretical results.

Author Keywords: Virus infection model. Nonlinear immune response

articleTitle: Graphic Identification System's Design and Research Based on Graphics Primitive
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: To resolve the difficulty of reading and identifying the CAD graphics file about automatic distinguishing and judging of CAD graphics file, this paper propses a CAD graphics identification method based on the graphics primitive. In this method, the CAD graphics is exploded to graphics primitive and read the graphics attribute. According to the comparison results of the identified graphics and standard graphics, the graphics primitives are differentiated with their graphics attributs. The graphics identification is finished by reading different sorts of graphics primitives.

articleTitle: An Inverse Eigenvalue Problem for a Special Kind of Matrices
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper we study a kind of inverse eigen value problem for a special kind of real symmetric matrices: the real symmetric Arrow-plus-Jacobi matrices. That is, matrices which look like arrow matrices forward and Jacobi backward, from the (p,p)station, 1 ≤ p ≤ n. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of such two matrices. Our results are constructive, in the sense that they generate an algorithmic procedure to construct the matrix.

articleTitle: A Comparative Research of the Comprehensive Economic Strengths of the Five Coastal Provinces or Municipality
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Use the principal component analysis to appraise over the comprehensive economic strengths of the four coastal provinces named Jiangsu, Guangdong, Shandong, and Zhejiang and the municipality Shanghai, Three main components are extracted, the first stands for the total economy level, the second stands for the each province of industrial structure and level of activity, the third stands for quality of life and human culture education technology in economic growth role. Then ranks the five provinces three main component scores and their comprehensive score, Meanwhile, adopts TOPSIS method to carry on sorting the comprehensive evaluation score, principal component analysis and TOPSIS method for comparison, At last, conclusions are drawn and policy suggestions are put forward accordingly.

articleTitle: The Computer Numerical Simulations and Qualitative Analysis of a Predator-Prey Model with Nonlinear Increasing Rate
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper a class of two species mutual interference predator-prey model with nonlinear increasing rate and functional response is studied. The stability of equilibrium, the sufficient conditions of nonexistence and conditions of the existence and uniqueness of the limit cycle around the positive equilibrium of the system are discussed. Some new results obtained, the theoretical results in this paper are confirmed by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A Predator-Prey System with Mutual Interference Concerning IPM
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: A predator-prey system with mutual interference concerning Integrated Pest Management (IPM) is considered. The locally stable prey-eradication periodic solution is obtained when the impulsive period is less than some critical value by using Floquet theorem and small amplitude perturbation skills. Otherwise, the system is permanent. Numerical examples show that the system considered has more complicated dynamics behaviors, such as: (1) high-order periodic oscillation, (2) period-doubling bifurcation, (3) symmetry-breaking bifurcation, (4) attractor crisis, etc. Finally, some conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Cross-Weighted Centroid with Application to the Extraction of Affine Invariants
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, cross-weighted centroid (CWC) is constructed to extract affine invariant features. Every point in an image is assigned with a cross-weight based on the distribution of the image. CWC, derived from these weighted points, is affine invariance. Based on the original centroid and CWC of the image, a series of centroids of some affine regions can be obtained by iterating affine region cutting, i.e., ARC. Several affine invariant triangles are constructed. Consequently, affine invariant features can be derived by the area of these triangles. Experiment results show the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Spatial Statistical Analysis of Regional Economy in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper we discuss the differences of development level of regional economy in Jiangsu province by means of spatial statistical methods. The empirical results show that the development of regional economy in Jiangsu province presents spatial agglomeration. The spatial characteristic of region can't be ignored while studying disparity of regional economy.

articleTitle: A New Fast Intensity Inhomogeneity Estimate Method
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a new fast bias field method, which is based on adapted K-means and a smooth intensity fitting function. The experiments results show that our method can obtain good results.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Grid-Point Detection Method in a Pseudo-Random Structured Light Pattern
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive grid-point detection method is developed in a pseudo-random color pattern. In the proposed method, weighted cross mask convolution and non-maximal suppression are carried out to the pattern to obtain several grid-point candidates. In order to accurately measure the point symmetry of the candidates, Harris corner detector is used to adaptively select the suitable window size. Finally, the grid-points are recognized by comparing the symmetry characteristic with a given threshold. Some experiments have been conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Bounds for Spectral Norm and Frobenius Norm Condition Number of a Simple Matrix
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, we give the estimations both of spectral and Frobenius norm condition number of a simple matrix. The estimations can be used to measure the sensitivity of the solution of linear systems.

articleTitle: Study on Virtual Multi-function Display Development Technology Based on Personal Computer
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Modern airplane's multi-function displays have much more powerful functions. They are very important equipment for information interaction. The simulation design principle is showed for virtual multi-function display. And key technologies involved in the developing process are studied, for example, three-dimensional models' building, dynamic displaying technology, simulation data interaction, etc. All the studies establish the foundation for simulation training systems' developing.

articleTitle: Heat Transfer Process Simulation and Analysis of Vacuum Freeze Dryer Vapor Captor
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Vacuum freeze dryer vapor captor was taken as the study object, and a mathematical model of freeze dryer vapor captor heat transfer process was established to simulate and analyze heat transfer process. In the condition of low temperature and low pressure, influence of frosting in vapor captor heat transfer process was researched, the varied rule of frosting thickness and density in different time was obtained. The results show that with increasing of time, the frost thickness and density increase, heat transfer coefficient reduces. After 20 hours, frost thickness is about 9.6mm, then, increases with a gentle speed.

articleTitle: A Survivability Strategy in Mobile Network by Using Key Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The capability to provide network service even under a significant network system element disruption is the backbone for the survival of network technology in today's world, keeping this view in mind, the present paper highlights cryptosystem. A global initial key distribution method based on public key certificate chain shall be presented.

articleTitle: Perimeter Measure Analysis of Chaotic Attractor for Tube-Wall Pressure Fluctuations Signal in the Horizontal Kenics Static Mixer
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Static mixers are widely used in process industry especially in process intensification fields. Fluctuations information of tube-wall pressure in the KSM with a diameter 100mm and an aspect ratio 2 was got by high speed collector under different inlet velocities. Perimeter measure analysis had been used to characterize the chaotic attractor characterization. Experiments result indicated that the attractor area and the secondary axial length have the same tendency with the increase of time delay. The linear growth rate of the area was employed to characterize the geometric shape of attractor. An optimum operation condition, Q=0.8 m3/h, could be selected for better mixing performance.

articleTitle: Wind-Induced Vibration Analysis in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Based on harmonic superposition method (WAWS method) under the situation of multiple fluctuating wind speed, the spatial correlation of multi-point and Simiu spectrum were considered. Meanwhile decimation in time Fast Fourier Transform method (DIT-FFT method) was carried on optimizing the speed of wind. Then the fluctuating wind speed long direction of wind was simulated.

Author Keywords: wind-induced vibration analysis in time domain

articleTitle: Numerical Methods for Solving High Order Polynomial Equations
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The problem of finding the roots of a polynomial equation is important because many calculations in engineering and scientific computation can be summarized to it. An adaptive algorithm based on Sturm's theorem which could find the isolate intervals for all the real roots rapidly is used to locate all the roots. To find the numerical root, they will first be roughly approximated by dichotomy method. And then these roots are computed by Newton method using the initial values got in the first step. This method overcomes the shortcomings of dichotomy method and iterative method. The first step could find a good initial point quickly for Newton method, and Newton method converges faster than dichotomy method. Numerical example shows the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Solving Optimal Approximation Problems with Generalized Symmetry Constrains
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: This paper provides a direct method to solve the optimal approximation problem with generalized symmetric constrains, and the general expression of the solution is also given.

articleTitle: Electronic City: A Key to Achieving Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: Nowadays, the concept of urban and urbanism in regards to problems such as increasing population, multiplicity in number of cities, air and noise pollution and traffic jams evolved in deep variation and changes. Recently, with this approach we will face the question of what is sustainable to the city and regarding goals of sustainable development, how we could implement the vision based on this theory in modern urbanism. It is obvious that rapid changes in physical and economical development joint with social changes will have an influence on live dynamic of cities. Information Technology is known as one of the most important elements in changes and development of the current world and consequences from it will have a direct impact on people. These changes will carry words such as: Electronic commerce, Electronic Banking, Electronic city and even electronic government. It's been many years that Electronic development is practically used in many countries yielding large capital returns and saving significant resources and capacities for those countries. Electronic city as one of the emerging concept which is born with the development of Information technology, in theoretical and practical field, it can cause innovation and creation by using social and economical capitals. Also it could be a model to achieve sustainable development goals and solve many problems of New Urbanism. Noticeably, with regards to this fact, more than half the world's population live in urban areas and concept of the city is in the center of major challenges and problems such as energy control, resource consuming and change in cities infrastructure, "sustainable city" and its creation will not be possible unless we again have an approach to city development in the form of sustainability concept. Finally, Goal of this paper is to introduce overall aim of sustainable development and consider the role and necessity of electronic city and required infrastructure in order to make it practical.

articleTitle: Research on the Parallel Solving for Tri-diagonal Linear Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: This paper introduces two methods for the solution of tridiagonal systems: exchange algorithm (the forth and back method) and parallel algorithm (partition method). We compare the solving process and complexity of the two types of algorithms, especially the communication complexity and computational complexity. We analyze the main facts of the efficiencies of partition method and double partition method. In conclusion, we sum up the deficiencies and shortcomings of the forth and back method and partition method, and put forward a new useful parallel algorithm which is simple and practical.

articleTitle: Applying Random Function to Simulate Randomness of Refracted Flow
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The phenomena of refracted flow exist in sudden expansion flow. Under condition of symmetric boundary, flow refracts randomly. Computing sudden expansion flow, the random function can be used to generate a random number. It can determine direction of iterating. The numerical simulation can correspond with results of experiment in this way.

articleTitle: Stress Analysis of the Mine Hoist Spindle Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In this paper, the three dimensional modeling of 2JK mine hoist spindle was established by using Pro/ E according to given data. Then the model was inputed into the finite element analysis in ANSYS, the stress distribution of the spindle was obtained, strength check of the dangerous section was made at the same time, which provides a accurate and reliable theoretical basis for improving the spindle structural design.

articleTitle: Some Application of Markov Chain to Market Occupation Rate and Promotion Strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: The emphasis in this paper is mainly on the basic principle of Markov chain theory and its application to market occupation rate and promotion strategy. By scientific and reasonable information of the market occupation rate and promotion strategy, we tries to help enterprises achieve the objective of the maximum expected profit according to market analysis and different selling states.

articleTitle: A Numerical Investigation of Effects of Different Nozzle Spacing on Turbulent Flow in a Novel Circular Jet Mixer
publicationTitle: 2011 Fourth International Conference on Information and Computing
abstract: In order to investigate the flow characteristic in a novel circular jet mixer (CJM), the three-dimensional flow field of CJM with different nozzles spacing are investigated using CFD. The effects of different distances of nozzles are evaluated by the turbulent flow index, such as velocity and the self-similarity of the axial velocity, through the jet plane. Results show that larger nozzle spacing needs a longer jet length to complete the combination of the three jet flow, compared to the lower distance of nozzles. A linear equation is obtained to describe the attenuation of the axial velocity on different nozzles spacing. The self-similarity of the velocity at nozzles spacing is H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>/D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>=5 present a similarity to the free turbulent jet. The conditions of multi-nozzle turbulent flow also give help to investigate the mixing effects in the CJM.
